entities.summary: Roger Paul Morin was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the third bishop of Biloxi in Mississippi from 2009 to 2016. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of New Orleans from 2003 to 2009.
